text.content: Failures are a normal part of orchestrated systems. However, not every failure means the workflow should stop immediately. Many failures are temporary and may disappear if the operation is attempted again.

text.content: Retries are a common resilience pattern that allows workflows to recover from short-lived issues such as network interruptions, API timeouts, or temporarily unavailable agents. Instead of failing immediately, the workflow makes another attempt before giving up.
